answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Tending a whisper, watching a reef, and naming a mesa is the rhythm of earning trust — deliberately, repeatably, and never in bulk.
